items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 September 2026 11:33am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 30 September 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

A deep area of low pressure to the west of Ireland tracks north and fills.


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, but 4 towards Liverpool Bay, gradually decreasing 4 or 5 in all waters this evening, then veering Southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, but slight towards Liverpool Bay, falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing South or Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow evening, decreasing 4 or 5 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and showers spread from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers later.
